# Awesome Agent Recovery

A selective research bibliography on **recovering failing tool-using LLM agents**. 57 original research publications curated as of 4 November 2026. The project is not a general agent framework, product, or observability directory.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery
Updated: 2026-11-04

## Research and navigation

- [Curated 57-paper README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery/main/README.md): Annotated research, core recovery questions, and safe-retry decision model.
- [Curated catalog CSV](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery/main/data/resources.csv): Single editable paper index, scholarly URL, code link if any, evidence note.
- [Derived JSON catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery/main/data/resources.json): Machine-readable same paper set.
- [Curation evidence policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery/main/docs/research-decision.md): Publication-only, direct recovery, uniqueness and empirical-evidence gates.
- [131-item keep/remove audit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery/main/docs/curation-audit-2026-11-04.md): Explanation for each of 57 keeps and 74 removals.
- [Benchmark and measurement guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery/main/docs/benchmarks.md): Detect, attribute, intervene, verify, and measure real effects separately.
- [Recovery field guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery/main/docs/field-guide.md): Safe retries, in-flight commits, restoration and compensation.
- [Research FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery/main/docs/faq.md): Practical boundaries and scope.
- [Contribution guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MohammadAsadolahi/Awesome-Agent-Recovery/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Propose, justify, and validate papers.

## Evidence interpretation

Paper results are author-reported unless independently reproduced. A correct diagnosis does not prove successful recovery; a checkpoint does not undo arbitrary external writes. Claims about safe retries and exactly-once effects depend on external tool contracts. The earlier larger catalog and research roundups are preserved in Git history, not promoted as current recommendations.
